description: Update an existing ABAP domain. Locks, updates with provided parameters (complete replacement), unlocks, and optionally activates.

conversion_exit.description: Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

datatype.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

fixed_values.description: Array of fixed values for domain value range

text.description: Description text for the fixed value

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Required for transportable packages.

value_table.description: Value table name for foreign key relationship

name: UpdateDomain
